verdict.rationale: Authy provides no official export feature for TOTP secrets, and community reports (authy-comm-3, authy-comm-4, authy-comm-10, authy-comm-18) confirm the app deliberately blocks migration/export, with users resorting to hacky workarounds like extracting keys via a deprecated Chrome extension debug mode (authy-comm-13, authy-comm-14). Docs never claim an export feature exists — only backup/sync within Authy's own ecosystem (authy-docs-5, authy-docs-3). missing for 10: any documented open/standard export format, first-party export tool, official migration path preserving secrets, and evidence contradicting the well-documented lock-in behavior.
